title: Microsoft Excel
description: Learn spreadsheets from the first cell to formulas, charts, sorting and filtering, with hands-on activities and projects.

lessons.title: Final Project: My School Workbook
lessons.summary: Put every skill together in one workbook.

blocks.text: Students create a workbook called "My School Workbook" containing four worksheets:
Sheet 1: My Class List (formatted with Home tab tools).
Sheet 2: My Favourite Fruits (includes pictures, shapes, and a chart using the Insert tab).
Sheet 3: My Marks (uses SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, and COUNT formulas).
Sheet 4: My Attendance (uses sorting, filtering, and attendance drop-down lists from the Data tab).
